measured_at_commit_means: the HEAD the run was taken against; the commit that lands this artefact is its child

method.annulus: one binary mask render per band through annulus.gdshader; a depth image does not survive this renderer's sRGB output
method.camera: placed on TerrainMesh.drawn_surface_y, not on the heightfield. The two differ by a mean of 36 m and an eye on the field is underground.
method.coverage: plant pixels over ground pixels in the band; may exceed 1
method.curve: the range-matched candidate's attenuation is FITTED to the oracle's own binned brightness in this run, not chosen
method.ground_pixels: the terrain rendered ALONE through the same annulus
method.isolated: instances with the ground hidden; a tint with the ground written black by the shader, because a tint IS the ground

not_covered: one machine and one seam distance. No crossfade is measured: each candidate is scored as if it were the whole far field.
